summary: Retest of the admin-login normalisation fix (case-insensitive username, whitespace-trimmed password). All 6 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised via 2 new backend test files + 2 new browser checks, plus reruns of 2 pre-existing browser checks. 9 checks passed, 1 flaky (pre-existing test-suite parallel-worker race unrelated to the fix). Fix verified correct: exact reported case works, real-world input variants (Admin/ADMIN/padded username, trailing-space password) log in, genuinely wrong credentials/unknown username/inner-space password are still rejected with 401, mobile admin panel is fully usable, password change round-trips correctly, and a fresh database self-provisions one lowercase admin + settings + 33 categories idempotently. Admin password confirmed restored to Mahesh@2026 at the end.

action_items.description: tests/test_tscheck_login_normalization.py (and the pre-existing test_tscheck_product_crud.py / test_tscheck_product_hide_delete.py) intermittently fail under the required `-n 2 --dist loadscope` pytest config with 'Invalid username or password' (401) when they happen to run concurrently with test_tscheck_change_password.py on a different worker, because that test transiently mutates the shared admin password mid-suite. All affected files pass 100% of the time under serial execution (`-n 0`, the alternative pytest.ini itself documents), and the live API confirms the real credential state is always correct before and after the run. This is a pre-existing shared-state race in the generated test suite (not caused by this iteration's normalization fix) — not reporting as an app bug, but flagging since it will keep surfacing on every rerun of the full suite with default addopts.

checks.criterion: The user's exact reported case works: logging in through the UI with username 'admin' and password 'Mahesh@2026' reaches the admin dashboard.
checks.name: admin-login-and-auth-guard
checks.evidence: Rerun by name: fresh /admin visit redirected to /admin/login; wrong password kept user on login with visible inline error; admin/Mahesh@2026 navigated to /admin and rendered tab-dashboard/tab-products/tab-categories/tab-rates/tab-settings. No 401 surfaced for the successful login POST.

checks.criterion: Login tolerates the real-world input variants that previously caused the reported failure.
checks.name: admin-login-input-variants
checks.evidence: 5 UI login+logout cycles each asserted the /api/auth/login response was HTTP 200 and landed on /admin with tab-dashboard visible: username 'Admin', username 'ADMIN', username 'admin ' (trailing space), password 'Mahesh@2026 ' (trailing space), and both fields padded (' admin ' / ' Mahesh@2026 ').

checks.criterion: Login tolerates the real-world input variants that previously caused the reported failure.
checks.name: test_login_tolerates_case_and_whitespace_variants (test_tscheck_login_normalization.py)
checks.evidence: Serial run (`pytest -n 0`): POST /api/auth/login 200 + mj_session cookie set for all 5 variants (Admin/ADMIN/padded username/padded password/both padded), repeated 3x clean. Under the suite's default `-n 2 --dist loadscope` config it intermittently returns 401 for the 'both padded' variant when racing test_tscheck_change_password.py's transient password mutation on the other worker -- same pre-existing infra race noted in action_items, not a regression from this fix.

checks.criterion: Genuinely wrong credentials are still rejected — the tolerance must not weaken authentication.
checks.name: test_wrong_password_still_rejected / test_unknown_username_still_rejected / test_inner_space_in_password_still_rejected / test_admin_products_requires_auth_no_cookie (test_tscheck_login_normalization.py)
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login admin/TotallyWrong1 -> 401, no cookie. POST /api/auth/login notadmin/Mahesh@2026 -> 401, no cookie. POST /api/auth/login admin/'Mahesh @2026' (inner space) -> 401, no cookie. GET /api/admin/products with no cookie -> 401.

checks.criterion: Genuinely wrong credentials are still rejected — the tolerance must not weaken authentication.
checks.name: admin-login-and-auth-guard
checks.evidence: Same rerun as above: wrong password ('wrong-password-xyz') kept the user on /admin/login with a visible inline error; unauthenticated visit to /admin redirected to /admin/login.

checks.criterion: After logging in, the admin panel is fully usable so the owner can actually manage the shop.
checks.name: admin-dashboard-usable-mobile
checks.evidence: At 390x844: Products tab admin-product-list showed exactly 6 admin-product-row-* entries; Rates tab admin-rate-gold-24k contained '74500' and admin-rate-silver-999 contained '9450'; Settings tab admin-setting-phone contained '9837149835' and the Change Admin Password fields (admin-current-password, admin-new-password, admin-change-password-button) were visible.

checks.criterion: Admin password change still works end-to-end after the normalisation change, including with padded input.
checks.name: admin-change-password-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun by name: wrong current password rejected (change-password response not ok, nothing changed); correct current + new password (TscheckTemp123!) succeeded and caller stayed signed in (tab-settings still visible); old password then rejected at login, new password worked; restored original password and verified via POST /api/auth/login 200.

checks.criterion: Admin password change still works end-to-end after the normalisation change, including with padded input.
checks.name: test_wrong_current_password_rejected / test_change_password_then_restore (test_tscheck_change_password.py)
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/change-password with wrong current_password -> 400/401, original password still logs in. Correct current + new password -> 200, caller session stays valid, old password login -> 401, new password login -> 200; password restored to Mahesh@2026 in a finally block and re-verified with a final login call (200).

checks.criterion: A fresh/production-style database still self-provisions a working admin account after the normalisation change.
checks.name: test_fresh_database_self_provisions_admin (test_tscheck_fresh_db_provision.py)
checks.evidence: Against temp DB 'tscheck_fresh_provision_db' (never 'app'): ensure_indexes()+ensure_default_admin()+ensure_business_defaults() created exactly 1 admin doc with username=='admin' (lowercase); verify_credentials('Admin', 'Mahesh@2026') and ('admin','Mahesh@2026') both True; settings doc with key='site' present; 33 categories seeded. Re-running all three functions kept exactly 1 admin and 33 categories (idempotent). Temp database dropped in fixture teardown; confirmed absent afterwards via list_database_names().
